children: Evolution Petroleum Corp reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue essentially flat at $86.34M while the company recorded a net loss of ($2.43M) and diluted EPS of ($0.08), compared with net income of $1.47M and EPS of $0.03 in the prior year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per common share”.
Portfolio diversification across non-operated working, mineral and royalty interests in SCOOP/STACK, Williston, Barnett and the Permian supports flexible capital allocation.
Proved reserves were approximately 27.2 MMBOE with about 82% developed; fiscal-year production was steady at roughly 7,077 BOEPD, underpinning ongoing cash flow.
Acquisitions in SCOOP/STACK, Louisiana, the Permian and other mineral purchases added acreage and about 1.6 MMBOE of proved reserves, supporting growth opportunities.

Operational activity included bringing multiple SCOOP/STACK wells online and converting Chaveroo wells to rod pumps; fiscal capex was about $5.5M with a FY27 budget of $4–6M (excluding a recent Permian purchase).
Hedging and derivative activity increased after acquisitions to stabilize cash flow; derivative volatility materially affected realized results in FY26.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
